description: Navigate sections with F6 and Shift+F6, open sidebar pages and Settings with Control+1 through Control+6, search with Control+S, use Home and End in track lists, and play the focused track with Enter. Control+Alt+Down suggests less and Control+Alt+Up favorites and Control+Alt+Shift+Up removes favorites. Author: serrebidev. GitHub: https://github.com/serrebidev/AppleMusicNVDA.
